name: toast
title: Toast
description: Actionable feedback on Base UI Toast that docks into a host cell or floats at the inline-end corner: done, failed, info, warning and loading kinds, a description line, one action (Undo, Retry), the countdown draining the keyline. useToaster() and createToaster() add promise tracking, update and dismiss, and calls from outside React.
whenToUse: Use it for a short record of something that just happened, with at most one action such as Undo. For something that stays true where it sits use Notice.

parts.name: ToastAction
parts.description: The action cell (Undo, Retry): paper on the ink toast, yellow on hover. A cell sets no border: the row of cells draws the divider before it.

parts.name: ToastClose
parts.description: The dismiss cell. It shows only an icon, so it needs a name.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

parts.name: ToastDock
parts.description: DOCKED feedback: the viewport inside a host cell (e.g. the table pager), rendering the manager's toasts. The front message fills the cell and counts the ones waiting (+2); hovering or focusing the dock unfolds them upward on shared seams. The undo countdown drains the bottom keyline and pauses with the timers. Swipe toward the inline end to dismiss.

props.name: container
props.description: Floating only: where the portal renders (defaults to <body>).

props.name: portalProps
props.description: Floating only: props for Base UI's Toast.Portal.

props.name: timeout
props.description: The countdown's length for a toast that names no timeout: the provider's `timeout` (default 6000).

parts.name: ToastFloating
parts.description: Floating fallback for pages without a dock, at the bottom inline-end corner. The newest message is in front (an ink 2px frame); older ones wait behind it as paper cards whose top keylines peek above it. Hover or keyboard focus fans the stack out into a column and pauses every timer. Swipe down or toward the inline end to dismiss.

props.name: container
props.description: Floating only: where the portal renders (defaults to <body>).

props.name: portalProps
props.description: Floating only: props for Base UI's Toast.Portal.

props.name: timeout
props.description: The countdown's length for a toast that names no timeout: the provider's `timeout` (default 6000).

parts.name: ToastProvider
parts.description: Wrap the app once. Up to `limit` (3) messages stay at once, newest in front; older ones wait behind it as a stack and come forward as the newer ones close. Pass `toastManager={toaster}` (from `createToaster()`) to raise messages from outside React too.

parts.name: ToastRoot
parts.description: One message: Base UI's Toast.Root, drawn for the viewport it is in. It marks its kind (data-kind: done, failed, info, warning, loading), whether it is in front (data-kl-front) and whether it waits behind the front one (data-kl-behind). It swipes away toward the inline end (a floating one also down) unless `swipeDirection` says otherwise.

parts.name: ToastViewport
parts.description: Where toasts show: Base UI's Viewport (the F6 landmark; hover and keyboard focus expand it and pause the timers). `placement="floating"` adds Base UI's Portal and carries the configuration of the place it is written. Give it ToastRoot children, or use ToastDock / ToastFloating, which render the manager's toasts.

props.name: container
props.description: Floating only: where the portal renders (defaults to <body>).

props.name: placement
props.description: dock (default): in flow, inside a host cell · floating: fixed at the bottom inline-end corner, in a portal.

props.name: portalProps
props.description: Floating only: props for Base UI's Toast.Portal.
